env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

cd dotted
logos build -o $WORK/bin/dotted$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr -count=1 'go: warning: \[portability::alias_extension\] main\.📜: loGo/s alias extension file'
! stderr 'error'
exists $WORK/bin/dotted$GOEXE
logos build ./lib
stderr -count=2 'portability::alias_extension'
stderr -count=1 'lib\.⚡:'
stderr -count=1 'lib_test\.⚡:'
cd ..

cd plain
logos build -o $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE
logos build ./lib
! stderr .
cd ..

cd canonical
logos build -o $WORK/bin/canonical$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/canonical$GOEXE
cd ..

cd gomod
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gomod$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

cd denymod
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/denymod$GOEXE .
stderr 'portability::alias_extension'
! exists $WORK/bin/denymod$GOEXE
cd ..

cd denyallow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/denyallow$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/denyallow$GOEXE
exec $WORK/bin/denyallow$GOEXE
stdout '^allow deny ok$'
cd ..

cd allowpos
logos build -o $WORK/bin/allowpos$GOEXE .
stderr -count=2 'portability::alias_extension'
! stderr 'ok\.📜'
exists $WORK/bin/allowpos$GOEXE
exec $WORK/bin/allowpos$GOEXE
stdout '^helped$'
stdout '^extra$'
stdout '^ok quiet$'
cd ..

-- dotted/go.mod --
module example.com/dotted

go 1.27
-- dotted/cmd/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("dotted ok")
}
-- dotted/lib/lib.⚡ --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }
-- dotted/lib/lib_test.⚡ --
package lib

import "testing"

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "lib" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}
-- plain/go.mod --
module plain

go 1.27
-- plain/cmd/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("plain ok")
}
-- plain/lib/lib.⚡ --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }
-- plain/lib/lib_test.⚡ --
package lib

import "testing"

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "lib" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}
-- canonical/go.mod --

-- canonical/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	fmt.Println("canonical ok")
}

	fmt.Println("go ok")

-- denymod/go.mod --
module example.com/denymod

-- denymod/logos.toml --
[lints]
portability = "deny"

-- denymod/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("deny ok")
}

-- denyallow/go.mod --
module example.com/denyallow

go 1.27

-- denyallow/logos.toml --
[lints]
portability = "deny"

-- denyallow/main.📜 --
//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("allow deny ok")
}

-- allowpos/go.mod --
module example.com/allowpos

go 1.27

-- allowpos/ok.📜 --
//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok quiet")
}

-- allowpos/abovefunc.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)
func helper() string {
	return "helped"
}

func init() {
	fmt.Println(helper())
}

-- allowpos/blankline.📜 --
//logos:allow(portability::alias_extension)

package main

import "fmt"

func extra() string {
	return "extra"
}

func init() {
	fmt.Println(extra())
}
